paper.title_en: Tracking the Evolution of Supermassive Black Hole Binaries with Pulsar Terms
paper.abstract_en: Pulsar timing arrays will soon be able to resolve the loudest supermassive black hole binaries contributing to the stochastic gravitational wave background at nanohertz frequencies. While the few decades of observations are typically not enough to see these binaries evolve in frequency, the so-called pulsar terms offer a glimpse into the past and can help us map out the frequency evolution of these binaries over tens of thousands of years. Measuring this long-term frequency evolution can allow us to look for deviations from a vacuum binary evolution due to various environmental effects. We develop a Fisher-matrix approach to calculate how precisely the frequency can be tracked over time in this manner, and demonstrate its use on a realistic near-future pulsar timing array with a 30-year baseline. We find that the environmental effects predicted by 2-dimensional hydrodynamic simulations of circumbinary disks are unlikely to be detectable in the circular binaries we considered, however, in some cases they might result in biased chirp mass recovery if ignored. We also demonstrate how this approach allows one to test the orbital evolution predicted by general relativity in a purely gravitational-wave driven inspiral, and to put upper limits on additional generic environmental effects described by a power-law hardening model.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将脉冲星项用于追踪超大质量双黑洞在数万年尺度上的频率演化，提出了基于Fisher矩阵的精度估计方法，并讨论了对双星环境效应、啁啾质量偏差以及广义相对论轨道演化的检验能力，与PTA主题高度相关且有明确的方法学和可检验预言。
decision.title_zh: 利用脉冲星项追踪超大质量双黑洞的演化
decision.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列不久将能够分辨出在纳赫兹频率上对随机引力波背景贡献最大的超大质量双黑洞。虽然数十年的观测通常不足以看到这些双星在频率上的演化，但所谓的脉冲星项提供了一窥过去的窗口，可以帮助我们描绘这些双星在数万年时间尺度上的频率演化。测量这种长期频率演化可以让我们寻找由于各种环境效应而偏离真空双星演化的情况。我们发展了一种Fisher矩阵方法，用以计算以这种方式能够在时间上多精确地追踪频率，并在一个具有30年基线的现实近未来脉冲星计时阵列上演示了其应用。我们发现，二维流体动力学模拟的环双星盘所预言的环境效应在我们所考虑的圆轨道双星中不太可能被探测到，然而在某些情况下，如果忽略这些效应，它们可能导致啁啾质量恢复出现偏差。我们还展示了这种方法如何能够检验广义相对论在纯引力波驱动的旋进中所预言的轨道演化，并对由幂律硬化模型描述的额外一般性环境效应给出上限。
